prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one single “best” personal injury attorney for every car-accident case — the best lawyer for you depends on your facts (severity of injuries, fault disputes, need to sue a company or government, whether you want to go to trial, etc.). That said, Chicago has many highly experienced plaintiff firms. A few well-known options you can consider contacting for a free consultation:

- Clifford Law Offices  
- Levin & Perconti  
- Romanucci & Blandin  
- Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard  
- Corboy & Demetrio

How to choose the right attorney for your case
- Look for attorneys who focus on car-accident/personal-injury work (not general practice).  
- Check trial experience and verdicts/settlements in similar cases.  
- Read client reviews and peer-recognition (Super Lawyers, Martindale‑Hubbell, local bar awards).  
- Ask about their fee structure (contingency percentage, who advances costs).  
- Confirm who will actually handle your case (partner vs. junior associate).  
- Ask about communication expectations and typical case timeline.

Questions to ask at a free consultation
- Have you handled cases like mine? What were results?  
- Do you try cases or mainly settle?  
- What contingency fee and additional costs should I expect?  
- Who will handle day‑to‑day work and how often will you update me?  
- Do you anticipate bringing my case to trial?

Immediate practical steps
- Get medical care and follow treatment instructions.  
- Preserve evidence (photos, video, repair estimates, police report, medical records).  
- Avoid giving recorded statements to the insurer without a lawyer.  
- Be aware Illinois personal injury claims generally have a 2‑year statute of limitations from the accident date — act promptly.

If you’d like, tell me: what ZIP code you’re in and a short summary of the accident/injuries (no privileged details), and I can suggest attorneys near you or help draft questions for consultations.
